The absent claim of a protocol-22 census root: each node its posting node left out, with the 3 seatings (3 different closes in the 24 h) whose threshold-signed certificates show it drawn, or left out already, and present at none; the certificates; and the contracts of those rounds, so a client draws each itself (§5A.3, kanban #727). Every seat and the client check the proofs; a wrong one makes the census invalid. From protocol 26 the claim also carries `stalled`: each node left out with the 3 rounds whose seats named it, the notes and the certificates of those rounds' seatings (§5A.3 "Stalled in its rounds", kanban #1052).

post.description:
An auditor's audit of a paid round (§13A.1, protocol 22): taken once when it stands - signed by the node it names, its VRF proof good for this round under that key, the node eligible and drawn as an auditor, its results the ones this seat holds - and in time: signed within 5 s of this seat's clock and before the window close, or forwarded by another seat of the round by the close. A new one is handed on to the other seats.

**Needs a signature: the body or record must be signed by the key named below.**

**Changes state on the node:** this page does not send it.

Access: the auditor's signature over the AUDIT; a forwarded one also the forwarding seat's signature (a seat of the round)

Returns: 201 'AUDIT kept'; 200 'already held'; 400 not an AUDIT; 403 forwarder not a seat of the round or its signature wrong; 409 does not stand or too late

Headers: `x-audit-seat`, `x-audit-forward`

Source: `packages/arena-node/src/server.js` line 9931.
